name: Maho☆Tama Series ~Tekoki Hen~
original_name: まほ☆たまシリーズ ～手コキ編～
source:
Another item from "Maho-Tama" series. This game features "Tekoki (Rubbing with hands)". There is a rumor spreading in the community that to "Tekoki" Yoji's makes people relaxed. Don't think why "Tekoki" makes people relaxed. May pushes Miki, who is very nervous about the exams, to feel relaxed by "Tekoki". Miki thinks about whether to do it or not.... What will happen in the end of this "Tekoki" turmoil.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090215034545/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_46/products_id/1003671]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
“魔法蛋”系列的又一部作品。本作以“手交”为主题。社区中流传着一则传言：替洋二手交能让人放松。别去想手交为什么能让人放松。梅劝因考试而极度紧张的美希用手交来放松。美希正犹豫着该不该这么做……这场“手交”骚动最终会如何收场？

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090215034545/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_46/products_id/1003671]Eroge Shop[/url]]
